description: Every source agency, or the one named by source: name, homepage, terms URL, required notice, and status (live, paused, hand entry, or not collected), with any series the agency itself is late with. Figures are public statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Each result has a coverage line that says exactly what the figure covers (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Each result carries the notice its source requires, and our Terms ask that it stay with the figure. Facts, not investment or other advice.

source.description: One source id, e.g. BLS; default every source
